items.name: sphinx-needs
items.description: Sphinx-needs is a requirements management tool that allows you to manage requirements, specifications, and documentation within Sphinx.

items.name: Eclipse RMF
items.description: RMF is a framework for working with textual requirements, structured as ReqIF models, the industry standard for exchanging requirements. RMF uses natively ReqIF, the open standard for requirements exchange, allowing you to exchange requirements with many industry applications like Rational DOORS® or PTC integrity®.

items.name: OpenModellica
items.description: Introduction OPENMODELICA is an open-source Modelica-based1 modeling and simulation environment intended for industrial and academic usage.

items.name: Eclipse Capella
items.description: Eclipse Capella is a powerful and extensible MBSE software tool that leverages a field-proven language and method to successfully design the architecture of complex systems.

items.name: Eclipse Papyrus
items.description: Eclipse Papyrus is an industrial-grade open source Model-Based Engineering tool. Eclipse Papyrus has notably been used successfuly in industrial projects and is the base platform for several industrial modeling tools.

items.category: Software Component Verification and Integration Verification
items.name: Eclipse Apoapsis™ - ORT Server
items.description: The Eclipse Apoapsis project's ORT Server is a standalone application to deploy the OSS Review Toolkit as a service in the cloud.

items.category: Software Component Verification and Integration Verification
items.name: Dependency-Track
items.description: Dependency-Track is an intelligent Component Analysis platform that allows organizations to identify and reduce risk in the software supply chain by consuming SBOMs.

items.category: Software Component Verification and Integration Verification
items.name: OSS Review Toolkit (ORT)
items.subcategory: Software Composition Analysis Scanners and Analyzers
items.description: The OSS Review Toolkit (ORT) is a set of tools that work together to help you manage and analyze your software projects.

items.category: Software Component Verification and Integration Verification
items.name: Eclipse Dash License Tool
items.subcategory: Software Composition Analysis Scanners and Analyzers
items.description: The Eclipse Dash License Tool identifies the licenses of the content of a project's dependencies. It takes a list of dependencies as input, resolves each against the Eclipse Foundation's ClearlyDefined and IP Team databases, and reports the license information along with whether the content is approved for use.

items.category: Software Component Verification and Integration Verification

items.subcategory: Software Composition Analysis Scanners and Analyzers
items.description: cdxgen is a CLI tool, library, and server for generating CycloneDX Bill of Materials (SBOM, CBOM, OBOM, SaaSBOM, CDXA) for most languages, package managers, and container images.

items.category: Software Component Verification and Integration Verification
items.name: Eclipse S-CORE SBOM Tool
items.subcategory: Software Composition Analysis Scanners and Analyzers
items.description: Bazel rules that generate a Software Bill of Materials in SPDX 2.3 and CycloneDX 1.6 format for a given Bazel target.

items.category: Software Component Verification and Integration Verification
items.name: Syft
items.subcategory: Software Composition Analysis Scanners and Analyzers
items.description: Syft is a CLI tool and library for generating a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) from container images and filesystems.

items.name: Grype
items.subcategory: Software Composition Analysis Scanners and Analyzers
items.description: Grype is a vulnerability scanner for container images and filesystems.
